description: A contractor's backhoe severed the primary Shentel fiber trunk under I-81 near Radford at 7:52 AM. The regional 911 center is now routing calls over a single degraded path — dispatchers hear up to three seconds of silence and two callers have already hung up. A protected backup circuit exists, but traffic has not been switched to it. This is a drill, but treat every minute as real: a hung-up 911 call is still a hung-up 911 call.
visible_to: Shentel Communications;SW Virginia EMA;SW Virginia Sheriff's Coalition

incident: Stillwater Medical Center Loses Records Link
description: The same fiber cut took Stillwater Medical Center (Radford) offline from telehealth and remote-records access. Nurses are running on paper for six dialysis patients whose treatment protocols cannot be verified online. The clinic can connect to Carilion's system over a temporary link, but nothing has been arranged yet.
visible_to: Carilion Clinic System;Shentel Communications;Appalachian Faith & Community Network

incident: Traffic Signals Dark at I-81/I-77 Interchange
description: Controller cabinets at the I-81/I-77 interchange in Wytheville are offline — signals dark and backups growing on both approaches. VDOT crews are on scene but do not yet know whether this is a network failure or a power fault; AEP has not confirmed which.
visible_to: VDOT SW Region;AEP Appalachian Power;SW Virginia Sheriff's Coalition

description: A local page is claiming the outage is an EMP attack during a regional test. Calls are flooding the sheriff's office and the faith network hotline; some residents are asking whether they should evacuate. No authoritative statement has been issued yet.
visible_to: Governor's SW Virginia Liaison;Appalachian Faith & Community Network;SW Virginia Sheriff's Coalition
